fields.title: 📖 Ubayy ibn Kaʿb: A Little upon the Sunnah Is Better
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ubayy ibn Kaʿb** said:

***“Hold to the **path** and the **Sunnah**. For moderation upon the path of Allāh and His Sunnah is better than exertion against the path of Allāh and His Sunnah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Not every intense effort is accepted. The worth of a deed lies in its standing upon the **Sunnah**, ***sincerity***, and the path of the prophets — not in mere quantity or harshness.

immutable.source: al-Lālakāʾī, Sharḥ Uṣūl Iʿtiqād Ahl as-Sunnah wa-l-Jamāʿah, Bāb: Siyāq Dhikr man Rusima bi-l-Imāmah fī s-Sunnah, Juzʾ 1, Ṣ. 59–60, Athar Nr. 10.
